name: @sun-protocol/sun-mcp-server

tools.name: sunswap_get_wallet_address
tools.description: Get the active TRON wallet address for SUN.IO/SUNSWAP interactions.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

tools.name: sunswap_v3_collect
tools.description: Collect accrued fees from an existing SUNSWAP V3-style position. Before executing, estimates claimable fees via a read-only collect call.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

abi.description: Optional position manager ABI; if omitted, TronWeb will attempt to infer it.

tokenId.description: Token ID of the V3 position NFT.

recipient.description: Recipient of collected fees. If omitted, defaults to the active wallet address.

tools.name: sunswap_get_balances
tools.description: Get TRX and TRC20 balances for a wallet on TRON, useful for SUN.IO/SUNSWAP portfolio views.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

ownerAddress.description: Wallet address; if omitted, uses the active SUNSWAP wallet.

tokenAddress.description: Required for TRC20: token contract address

tokens.description: Assets to query. Include at least one entry, e.g. [{ type: 'TRX' }] or TRC20 tokens.

tools.name: sunswap_quote_exact_input
tools.description: Estimate SUNSWAP smart router swap results (exact input) by calling its quote/view function.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

functionName.description: Quote function name on the router (default: quoteExactInput). You may override if router uses a different name, e.g. getAmountsOut.

args.description: Arguments passed to the router quote function, in ABI order.

abi.description: Optional router ABI; if omitted, TronWeb will attempt to infer it.

tools.name: sunswap_read_contract
tools.description: Read data from a TRON smart contract used by SUN.IO/SUNSWAP (view/pure functions only).

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

address.description: Contract address in base58 or hex format.

functionName.description: Name of the view/pure function to call.

args.description: Optional array of arguments to pass to the function.

abi.description: Optional contract ABI; if omitted, TronWeb will attempt to infer it.

tools.name: sunswap_swap_exact_input
tools.description: Execute SUNSWAP smart router swapExactInput (or equivalent) using the pattern: get params -> build unsigned tx -> wallet sign -> broadcast.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

functionName.description: Swap function name on the router (default: swapExactInput).

args.description: Arguments passed to the router swap function, in ABI order.

value.description: Optional TRX amount in Sun to attach as call value.

abi.description: Optional router ABI; if omitted, TronWeb will attempt to infer it.

tools.name: sunswap_get_token_price
tools.description: Get latest token prices from SUN.IO / SUNSWAP public API using token addresses and/or symbols.

tokenAddress.description: Comma-separated TRON token addresses, e.g. TR7N...,TXYZ...

tools.name: sunswap_v2_add_liquidity
tools.description: Add liquidity to a SUNSWAP V2-style pool. If tokenA or tokenB is native TRX (T9yD14Nj9j7xAB4dbGeiX9h8unkKHxuWwb), addLiquidityETH is used automatically; otherwise addLiquidity(tokenA, tokenB, ...) is used.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

abi.description: Optional router ABI; if omitted, TronWeb will attempt to infer it.

amountADesired.description: Desired amount of token A (raw units).

amountBDesired.description: Desired amount of token B (raw units).

amountAMin.description: Minimum amount of token A to add. If omitted, defaults to amountADesired with a 5% slippage buffer.

amountBMin.description: Minimum amount of token B to add. If omitted, defaults to amountBDesired with a 5% slippage buffer.

to.description: Recipient address for LP tokens. If omitted, defaults to the active wallet address.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline for the transaction. If omitted, defaults to now + 30 minutes.

tools.name: sunswap_v2_remove_liquidity
tools.description: Remove liquidity from a SUNSWAP V2-style pool. If tokenA or tokenB is native TRX (T9yD14Nj9j7xAB4dbGeiX9h8unkKHxuWwb), removeLiquidityETH is used automatically; otherwise removeLiquidity(...) is used.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

abi.description: Optional router ABI; if omitted, TronWeb will attempt to infer it.

tokenA.description: Token A underlying contract address in the V2 pool (LP token is derived automatically from the factory).

tokenB.description: Token B underlying contract address in the V2 pool (LP token is derived automatically from the factory).

liquidity.description: Amount of LP tokens to burn.

amountAMin.description: Minimum amount of token A to receive. If omitted, it is computed from pool reserves based on the LP share with a 5% slippage buffer.

amountBMin.description: Minimum amount of token B to receive. If omitted, it is computed from pool reserves based on the LP share with a 5% slippage buffer.

to.description: Recipient of underlying tokens. If omitted, defaults to the active wallet address.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline for the transaction. If omitted, defaults to now + 30 minutes.

tools.name: sunswap_v3_mint_position
tools.description: Mint a new SUNSWAP V3 concentrated liquidity position. Supports auto-compute: if fee is omitted, defaults to 3000; if tickLower/tickUpper are omitted, reads pool currentTick and sets ±50*tickSpacing; if only one of amount0Desired/amount1Desired is provided, calculates the other from V3 math.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

abi.description: Optional position manager ABI; if omitted, TronWeb will attempt to infer it.

fee.description: Pool fee tier (e.g. 100, 500, 3000). Defaults to 3000 if omitted.

tickLower.description: Lower tick. If omitted, auto-set to currentTick - 50*tickSpacing.

tickUpper.description: Upper tick. If omitted, auto-set to currentTick + 50*tickSpacing.

amount0Desired.description: Desired amount of token0 (raw units). If only one side is provided, the other is auto-calculated.

amount1Desired.description: Desired amount of token1 (raw units). If only one side is provided, the other is auto-calculated.

amount0Min.description: Minimum amount of token0. Defaults to amount0Desired * 95%.

amount1Min.description: Minimum amount of token1. Defaults to amount1Desired * 95%.

recipient.description: Recipient of the position NFT. Defaults to active wallet.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline. Defaults to now + 30 minutes.

tools.name: sunswap_v3_increase_liquidity
tools.description: Increase liquidity of an existing SUNSWAP V3 position. If only one of amount0Desired/amount1Desired is provided along with token0/token1/fee, the other is auto-calculated. amountMin defaults to 5% slippage; deadline defaults to now + 30 min.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

tokenId.description: Token ID of the V3 position NFT.

token0.description: Token0 address. Required for single-sided auto-compute and approval.

token1.description: Token1 address. Required for single-sided auto-compute and approval.

fee.description: Pool fee tier for pool lookup. Defaults to 3000.

tickLower.description: Lower tick override. If omitted, reads from the existing on-chain position.

tickUpper.description: Upper tick override. If omitted, reads from the existing on-chain position.

amount0Desired.description: Desired additional amount of token0. Auto-computed if only amount1Desired is given.

amount1Desired.description: Desired additional amount of token1. Auto-computed if only amount0Desired is given.

amount0Min.description: Minimum additional token0. Defaults to amount0Desired * 95%.

amount1Min.description: Minimum additional token1. Defaults to amount1Desired * 95%.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline. Defaults to now + 30 minutes.

tools.name: sunswap_v3_decrease_liquidity
tools.description: Decrease liquidity of an existing SUNSWAP V3 position. If token0/token1/fee are provided, amount0Min/amount1Min are auto-calculated from V3 math with 5% slippage. deadline defaults to now + 30 min.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

tokenId.description: Token ID of the V3 position NFT.

token0.description: Token0 address. Providing token0/token1/fee enables auto amountMin computation.

fee.description: Pool fee tier for pool lookup. Defaults to 3000.

amount0Min.description: Minimum token0 to receive. Auto-calculated with 5% slippage if omitted.

amount1Min.description: Minimum token1 to receive. Auto-calculated with 5% slippage if omitted.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline. Defaults to now + 30 minutes.

tools.name: sunswap_send_contract
tools.description: Send a state-changing TRON contract transaction for SUN.IO/SUNSWAP, following the pattern: get params -> build unsigned tx -> wallet sign -> broadcast.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

address.description: Contract address in base58 or hex format.

functionName.description: Name of the state-changing contract function to call (e.g. swap, addLiquidity).

args.description: Optional array of arguments to pass to the function.

value.description: Optional TRX amount in Sun to attach as call value.

abi.description: Optional contract ABI; if omitted, TronWeb will attempt to infer it.

tools.name: sunswap_v4_mint_position
tools.description: Mint a new SUNSWAP V4 concentrated liquidity position. Uses Permit2 for token authorization. If pool doesn't exist, provide sqrtPriceX96 to auto-create. Supports auto-compute: if tickLower/tickUpper are omitted, defaults to ±100*tickSpacing from current tick; if only one amount is provided, calculates the other.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet or nile (default: mainnet)

tickLower.description: Lower tick. If omitted, auto-set to currentTick - 100*tickSpacing.

tickUpper.description: Upper tick. If omitted, auto-set to currentTick + 100*tickSpacing.

amount0Desired.description: Desired amount of token0 (raw units). Auto-computed if only amount1 given.

amount1Desired.description: Desired amount of token1 (raw units). Auto-computed if only amount0 given.

recipient.description: Recipient of the position NFT. Defaults to active wallet.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline. Defaults to now + 30 minutes.

sqrtPriceX96.description: Initial sqrtPriceX96 for pool creation. Required if pool doesn't exist.

createPoolIfNeeded.description: If true, auto-create pool if it doesn't exist (requires sqrtPriceX96).

tools.name: sunswap_v4_increase_liquidity
tools.description: Increase liquidity of an existing SUNSWAP V4 position. Uses Permit2 for token authorization. Requires token0/token1 for proper authorization. If only one amount is provided, calculates the other from position tick range.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet or nile (default: mainnet)

tokenId.description: Token ID of the V4 position NFT.

token0.description: Token0 contract address (base58). Required for authorization.

token1.description: Token1 contract address (base58). Required for authorization.

fee.description: Pool fee tier for lookup. Defaults to 500.

amount0Desired.description: Desired additional amount of token0 (raw units).

amount1Desired.description: Desired additional amount of token1 (raw units).

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline. Defaults to now + 30 minutes.

tools.name: sunswap_v4_decrease_liquidity
tools.description: Decrease liquidity of an existing SUNSWAP V4 position. Withdrawn tokens are sent to the caller via CLOSE_CURRENCY action.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet or nile (default: mainnet)

tokenId.description: Token ID of the V4 position NFT.

liquidity.description: Amount of liquidity to burn (raw units).

token0.description: Token0 contract address (base58). Required for pool lookup.

token1.description: Token1 contract address (base58). Required for pool lookup.

fee.description: Pool fee tier for lookup. Defaults to 500.

amount0Min.description: Minimum token0 to receive. Defaults to 0 with slippage applied.

amount1Min.description: Minimum token1 to receive. Defaults to 0 with slippage applied.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline. Defaults to now + 30 minutes.

tools.name: sunswap_v4_collect
tools.description: Collect accrued fees from an existing SUNSWAP V4 position. Uses CLOSE_CURRENCY to collect all accumulated fees.

network.description: TRON network: mainnet or nile (default: mainnet)

tokenId.description: Token ID of the V4 position NFT.

token0.description: Token0 contract address (base58). Optional, can be read from position.

token1.description: Token1 contract address (base58). Optional, can be read from position.

fee.description: Pool fee tier. Optional, can be read from position.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline. Defaults to now + 30 minutes.

tools.name: sunswap_swap
tools.description: Execute a token swap on SUN.IO via the Universal Router. Automatically finds the best route, handles Permit2 approval/signing, and broadcasts the transaction. Only requires tokenIn, tokenOut, and amountIn.

tokenIn.description: Input token contract address (base58). Use TRX address for native TRX.

amountIn.description: Amount of input token in raw units (e.g. '1000000' for 1 USDT with 6 decimals).

network.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance as a decimal (e.g. 0.005 for 0.5%). Default: 0.005

tools.name: scanTransactions
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Use this endpoint to stream/snapshot recent swap, add-liquidity, and withdraw-liquidity transactions. Best for timeline analysis, activity feeds, and incremental sync with offset pagination.

protocol.description: Protocol to filter: V1, V1_5, V2, V3, V4, CURVE, ALL

tokenAddress.description: Token address to filter, can not be used with poolAddress

poolAddress.description: Comma-separated pool address to filter, can not be used with tokenAddress

type.description: Transaction type to filter: add, withdraw, swap

startTime.description: Start time (format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss or yyyy-MM-dd)

endTime.description: End time (format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss or yyyy-MM-dd)

tools.name: getTokens
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Get token metadata and key metrics by token address or protocol. Use this for token detail pages, token lists, and protocol-scoped token discovery.

protocol.description: Protocol: V1, V1_5, V2, V3, V4, CURVE, ALL

filterBlackList.description: Whether to filter out results that are in the blacklist. Set to true to exclude blacklisted tokens.

tools.name: searchTokens
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Search tokens by keyword (symbol/address) with optional protocol and sorting. Use when users provide fuzzy token input.

protocol.description: Protocol: V1, V1_5, V2, V3, V4, CURVE, ALL

filterBlackList.description: Whether to filter out results that are in the blacklist. Set to true to exclude blacklisted tokens.

tools.name: getProtocol
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Fetch current protocol-level overview metrics (TVL/liquidity, volume, etc.) for one protocol or all protocols.

protocol.description: Protocol: V1, V1_5, V2, V3, V4, CURVE, ALL

tools.name: getVolHistory
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Fetch daily protocol volume history between startDate and endDate for trend charts and historical analytics.

protocol.description: Protocol: V1, V1_5, V2, V3, V4, CURVE, ALL

tools.name: getUsersCountHistory
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Fetch daily active/participating user count history at protocol level.

protocol.description: Protocol: V1, V1_5, V2, V3, V4, CURVE, ALL

tools.name: getTransactionsHistory
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Fetch daily transaction count history at protocol level.

protocol.description: Protocol: V1, V1_5, V2, V3, V4, CURVE, ALL

tools.name: getPoolsCountHistory
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Fetch daily pool count history at protocol level.

protocol.description: Protocol: V1, V1_5, V2, V3, V4, CURVE, ALL

tools.name: getLiqHistory
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Fetch daily protocol liquidity history between startDate and endDate.

protocol.description: Protocol: V1, V1_5, V2, V3, V4, CURVE, ALL

tools.name: getPrice
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Get latest token prices by token address or symbol. Supports batch lookup with comma-separated input.

tokenAddress.description: Token address list, separated by comma

symbol.description: Token symbol or address list, separated by comma

tools.name: getUserPositions
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Fetch a user's liquidity positions across pools with optional protocol/pool filters, search, pagination, and sorting.

protocol.description: Protocol to filter: V1, V1_5, V2, V3, V4, CURVE, ALL

tools.name: getPoolUserPositionTick
tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Fetch all position ticks for a given concentrated-liquidity pool (poolAddress required).

tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Fetch pool list/details by pool address, token address, or protocol. Supports sorting and blacklist filtering.

tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Get paginated pools ranked by APY for yield discovery use cases.

tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Fetch daily liquidity history for a specific pool (poolAddress required).

tools.description: This endpoint is for SUN.IO (also called SUNSWAP). Query token pair records directly from pair_info with protocol/address filters, sorting, and pagination.
